children: AI could potentially cause catastrophic harm to humanity within the next decade, with Anthropic’s alignment work still lacking a clear solution for the risks posed by increasingly capable systems, according to Evan Hubinger, Alignment Science Lead at Anthropic
Hubinger said in a post on X that he "earnestly" believes AI could kill all humans, putting his personal estimate of the probability at more than 10% within the next decade.
He said Anthropic is “trying its best,” but that the company does not yet have a plan to solve alignment for superintelligence and is not clearly on track to do so.

The comments come as Anthropic's latest risk report assessed several AI-related risks, including misalignment in high-stakes settings and the possibility of AI systems accelerating research and development.
The report currently rated the risk from misalignment in high-stakes settings as low, up from its previous "very low" assessment.

Anthropic said it has observed misaligned behavior from its models, including willingness to take misaligned actions while attempting to complete difficult tasks, but considers the risk of catastrophic harm from known forms of misalignment low.

The company said severe, pervasive forms of unknown misalignment are considered very unlikely, while acknowledging increased uncertainty and limitations in its ability to assess future models. Its assessment relies partly on models' currently limited covert capabilities and extensive alignment testing.

The report separately rated risks from automated R&D as low but said confidence has fallen because some capability evaluations have "saturated" and the company is seeing early signs of AI-driven acceleration.
Anthropic added that its models are already significantly speeding up internal AI research, although not yet by a factor of two.

The company said the automated R&D threat could become a major concern within the next 6-12 months, underscoring the gap between current risk assessments and the longer-term concerns raised by Hubinger.

title: AI could kill every human on earth, Anthropic insider says
